description: This file contains cryptographic hash function implementations, including MD5 and SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 algorithms, with references to external cryptographic resources and specific class and method definitions related to hashing.

classes.name: MD5
classes.description: Class implementing MD5 hash algorithm with methods for updating and finalizing hash computation.

classes.name: SHA1
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-1 hash algorithm with methods for input processing, message padding, and block processing.

classes.name: SHA256
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-256 hash algorithm with methods for resetting, input processing, and finalizing the hash.

classes.name: SHA224
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-224 hash algorithm with similar methods to SHA256, including message padding and processing.

classes.name: SHA512
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-512 hash algorithm with methods for processing 1024-bit blocks, padding, and finalization.

classes.name: SHA384
classes.description: Class implementing SHA-384 hash algorithm, a truncated version of SHA-512, with methods for resetting, input, and finalizing.

methods.name: CloseContext
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation by padding the message and computing the final digest.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Processes input data for hashing, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operators to input strings or bytes into the hash computation.

methods.name: ProcessMessageBlock
methods.description: Processes a 512-bit block of the message for SHA-1.

methods.name: PadMessage
methods.description: Pads the message according to the hash standard before final processing.

methods.name: CloseContext
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation by padding the message, appending length, and processing the last block.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Processes input data, updating internal state and message blocks.

methods.name: sha256_trans
methods.description: Processes a message block for SHA-256, updating the hash state.

methods.name: sha512_transf
methods.description: Processes message blocks for SHA-512, updating the hash state.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the hash context to initial state.
